        .section .tdata,"awT",@progbits
        .globl  tls_var
        .type   tls_var,@object
tls_var:
        .quad   1
        .quad   2
        .size   tls_var, 16
        .text
        .globl  tls_marker
        .type   tls_marker,@function
tls_marker:
        movl    $3, %eax
        ret
        .size   tls_marker, .-tls_marker
        .section .note.GNU-stack,"",@progbits
